revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a large indoor public area with varied furniture, open sightlines, realistic foot traffic cues, industrial vinyl flooring, and partial shadow from nearby structure, with clear subject detail. Use an off-axis corridor view at closer inspection distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, and enough surrounding context to judge body support. The visible subject is a young adult man with a slim build, wearing a navy polo shirt and khaki trousers with subtle purple and gray casual clothing elements, sitting on a sturdy chair near the wall, with legs and seat support plainly visible. The scene should look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, with a few tools and boxes placed naturally in the background. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
